Control objective: Establish direction, policy, scope, objectives and accountability
Expected evidence: Approved policy, scope, objectives and review decisions

Control objective: Assign responsibilities, decision rights, competence and awareness
Expected evidence: Role matrix, competence criteria and training records

Control objective: Maintain inventory, intended purpose, lifecycle and change records
Expected evidence: System dossiers, release approvals and change history

Control objective: Identify, analyse, evaluate, treat and review AI risks
Expected evidence: Approved method, risk rationale, treatment and acceptance records

Control objective: Assess impacts on individuals, groups and society across lifecycle
Expected evidence: Impact assessments, consultation and reassessment records

Control objective: Govern data quality, provenance, purpose, access, retention and protection
Expected evidence: Data inventory, lineage, quality results and access reviews

Control objective: Assess and monitor suppliers, model providers and external dependencies
Expected evidence: Due diligence, contracts, assurance and change reviews

Control objective: Provide information on AI use, limitations and interaction
Expected evidence: Notices, user instructions and communication tests

Control objective: Define competent review, intervention, override and escalation
Expected evidence: Workflow design, training, review samples and override logs

Control objective: Maintain proportionate records to reconstruct relevant system events
Expected evidence: Versioned model/configuration logs and access-controlled records

Control objective: Protect AI assets, interfaces, data and service availability
Expected evidence: Threat assessments, security tests, access logs and resilience tests

Control objective: Detect, triage, contain, investigate and learn from AI incidents
Expected evidence: Incident procedure, exercise records and corrective actions

Control objective: Monitor objectives, evaluate controls and conduct independent audits
Expected evidence: Metrics, audit programme, workpapers and reports

Control objective: Address nonconformities, corrective actions and improvement opportunities
Expected evidence: Root-cause records, effectiveness checks and improvement log
